title: Hog raisers in Negros Occidental join pork holiday over mounting losses

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY – Some 25 associations of backyard hog raisers in Negros Occidental province have joined a three-day “pork holiday” called by the Agricultural Sector Alliance of the Philippines (AGAP) to protest mounting industry losses driven by government import policies and soaring production costs. Ric Lauron, president of the Alliance of Hog Raisers Association of Negros Occidental (AHRANO) on Friday sai.that local hog raisers have been affected by falling farmgate prices and high input costs. During the nationwide protest, which runs from Thursday to Saturday, participating hog raisers will halt pork sales and market deliveries, Lauron explained. He said that the […]...
